uint64_t MakeOpaqueSortKey(
    uint8_t pass,
    uint16_t pipeline,
    uint16_t material,
    uint16_t depthBucket)
{
    return
        (uint64_t(pass)        << 56) |
        (uint64_t(pipeline)    << 40) |
        (uint64_t(material)    << 24) |
        uint64_t(depthBucket);
}
